periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal tilt downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis of the visible right patch.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward teardrop tapering with the lowest point significantly distal to the geometric center.
